name: Black 510ML Stainless Steel Vacuum Insulated Thermos Flask Travel Mug with Temperature Display
description:
Enjoy your favorite drinks at the perfect temperature with this smart vacuum insulated sipper mug. Crafted from premium 304 stainless steel, it features an LED temperature display, flip lid, and leakproof design. With a 510ML capacity, it’s perfect for tea, coffee, or any hot and cold beverage on the go. Whether at work, traveling, or relaxing, it ensures freshness and comfort in every sip.Key Features:
 304-grade rust-proof stainless steel interior
 510ML capacity suitable for travel or office use
 LED smart temperature display on the lid
 Leakproof flip lid for secure portability
 Maintains hot or cold temperature up to 3 hoursHow to Use:
 Open lid and pour beverage inside
 Close the flip lid securely to prevent leaks
 Check the LED display for temperature reading
 Sip directly when ready
 Wash and dry thoroughly after useSafety Information:
 Do not microwave or freeze the flask
 Avoid overfilling to prevent spills
 Keep out of reach of children when filled with hot liquids

Package Includes:
 1 × 510ML Stainless Steel Sipper Mug with LED Display
